Cc: security@cloudscale.com
Date: 2026-12-13 09:12 -0800
Subject: Vendr access + CAIQ fragments for CloudScale

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick intros last week. We're ready to hand off the CAIQ fragments and a minimal SOC 2 summary into Vendr so your security team can complete the reconciliation. Two things I need from you to proceed:

1) Which Vendr account/email should I invite as the primary steward (we maintain separate roles for evidence upload vs. profile claims)?
2) Do you want us to upload a condensed SOC 2 summary (PDF) now or wait until we map the specific CAIQ fields to your profile?

I'm attaching a small spreadsheet with our current role-to-claim mapping and a zip of the CAIQ fragments (see attachments). If you prefer, we can create a temporary uploader role for you and push a compact evidence bundle.

Attachments: CloudScale_CAIG_fragments.zip (archive), role-map.csv (spreadsheet)

Happy to hop on a 20-min screen-share if that's faster.

Best,
Alex Turner
Security Lead, CloudScale
alex.turner@cloudscale.com
+1 415-555-0182

Alex — thanks.

Please invite vendr+uploads@redwoodinference.com as the primary steward for uploads; that address is monitored by our security intake queue and maps to a short-lived uploader role. For claim ownership, we'd like to keep the canonical claims with a named steward (we use "profile-owner@redwoodinference.com" for CAIQ/claims ownership).

Upload the condensed SOC 2 summary now so our reviewers can start the reconciliation pass while we line up claim authors. Also include a CSV of role->claim mapping (looks like you already did).

I'll loop in Marissa (security operations) and Karthik (portal config) to confirm the uploader role and any RBAC adjustments on our side.

- Logan
Logan Wright
Director, Security Programs | Redwood Inference

Logan — thanks for the ping. I've assigned this to Priya on the SOC2/evidence side and she will start the reconciliation tomorrow morning. Quick notes from my side after scanning their condensed PDF:

- SOC 2 summary includes control IDs but lacks a short KMS attestation and an encryption-in-transit narrative; we'll request the TLS certchain excerpt and the KMS key policy snapshot.
- The role->claim CSV is mostly aligned but their mapping marks several claims as "vendor-managed" that we treat as "shared responsibility"; I'll produce a short delta list we can send back to Alex.
- Karthik: please pre-provision vendr+uploads@redwoodinference.com with uploader-only permissions (attachments folder write, metadata write off). We prefer claims to remain immutable until ownership is agreed.

Alex — if you can grant the uploader invite now we'll have Priya pull the evidence and share the first-pass delta list by EOD tomorrow. If acceptable, please include a link to the CAIQ fragment bundle in Vendr (or paste a short presign link).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
